description: Students survey the solo art song repertoire of France, England, the Nordic countries, and the United States. The course highlights the significant features and development of the art song; provides context, approaches, and resources for studying this literature; and explores the differences and similarities between art song and other solo vocal literature, with a focus on the Great American Songbook. Offered spring semester in alternate years. Prerequisites: MUSIC 141 and MUSIC 214 or permission of instructor; MUSIC 263 and MUSIC 264 preferred.
